PV-H1.name: Semantic Retrieval Effect (REAL > SHUFFLED on retrieval)
PV-H1.summary: Replicated across 2 datasets x 2 models. All 4 CIs exclude zero. Effect sizes range 0.18-0.51.

PV-H2.name: Semantic Specificity (REAL > GENERIC on retrieval)
PV-H2.summary: 2/4 cells show GENERIC significantly better; 0/4 show REAL better. Hypothesis-specific semantics do not provide retrieval advantages over generic query expansion.

PV-H3.name: Downstream Utility Heterogeneity (retrieval helps HotpotQA but hurts SciFact accuracy)
PV-H3.summary: Clear dissociation: retrieval hurts SciFact accuracy (both models) while helping HotpotQA F1. The interaction is robust across models.

PV-H4.name: Model Transfer

evidence.scifact_retrieval_effect: Gemma +0.281, Llama +0.511 — same direction, Llama even stronger
evidence.scifact_accuracy_harm: Gemma -0.227, Llama -0.390 — same direction, Llama even worse
evidence.hotpotqa_retrieval_effect: Gemma +0.182, Llama +0.315 — same direction, Llama stronger
evidence.hotpotqa_f1_effect: Gemma +0.124, Llama +0.086 (n.s.) — same direction, Llama weaker

PV-H4.summary: Qualitative pattern replicates perfectly across models. Quantitative differences present but direction consistent on all 4 contrasts.

PV-H5.name: SciFact Failure Mechanism
PV-H5.mechanism: SHUFFLED retrieves zero gold evidence because shuffled hypotheses produce irrelevant queries. Without evidence to integrate, the model defaults to high-accuracy verdict patterns. REAL retrieves real evidence (+0.28-0.51 recall) but evidence integration introduces errors. Artifact visibility slightly harms accuracy (both models) consistent with hypothesis anchoring, but the primary mechanism is evidence integration failure, not anchoring.
PV-H5.summary: The failure is at the evidence-to-verdict integration step, not the artifact-to-query step.

unexpected_findings.shuffled_perfect_accuracy: SHUFFLED achieves ~100% accuracy on SciFact by retrieving zero relevant evidence. This is a measurement artifact: without evidence, the model produces default verdicts that happen to align with ground truth in this dataset.
unexpected_findings.generic_beats_real_retrieval: Generic query expansion without hypothesis content retrieves MORE gold evidence than hypothesis-specific queries on 3/4 dataset-model cells.
unexpected_findings.llama_stronger_retrieval_effects: Llama shows larger retrieval effects than Gemma on both datasets, possibly because Llama's retrieval queries are more dependent on the input artifact.
